youtube.baslik: How many people die from falls each year worldwide? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: According to the World Health Organization, falls are the second leading cause of unintentional injury deaths after road traffic injuries, with about 684,000 deaths each year. According to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, more than one in four people over 65 fall each year. Even without injury, fear of falling limits movement, and less movement weakens muscles and balance.
